name: usage-tracker
description: Reports this machine's Claude usage and the account's 5h/weekly limit readings to a shared usage server, with /usage-report to split usage between people.

server_url.title: Usage server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of the usage server, e.g. https://usage.example.com

access_token.title: Access token
access_token.description: One of the server's ACCESS_TOKENS; use a different token per person.
